messages:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — I'm taking the upcoming non-prod oncall shift (Fri 09:00-17:00 PT). Leaving a quick pre-oncall run-through so folks can swap in easily.
Maria S: Thanks Alex. Can you list the specific access checks you ran? I still don't have pager access in PD for the new team.
Alex K: Sure — TL;DR: VPN, bastion SSH, internal health endpoints, PagerDuty role, runbooks, and a smoke request to the replicas.
  - VPN: connected via Okta VPN (osx), verified internal routes.
  - Bastion: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/oncall alex@bastion.redwood.local` (should land on `oncall` user).
  - Health: `curl -I https://nonprod-api.redwood.internal/health` -> 200 OK.
  - PagerDuty: confirmed `oncall` role and notification rule.
  - Runbooks: looked at `/runbooks/oncall/nonprod-startup.md` and updated the pager escalation section.
Maria S: I don't see the PD role. Getting 403 when I try the PD console.
Jordan T: @infra-bot can you confirm Maria S is in the `oncall-nonprod` group in Okta? Also tagging infra since there was a recent AD sync that might have missed some users.
infra-bot: Okta sync job finished 12m ago. Groups changed: 2 users added, 1 failed (email mismatch). See https://infra.redwood.internal/okta/sync/2026-03-15
Priya R: Maria, try `pd whoami` (PagerDuty CLI). If that fails, I can open a ticket. Also check your auth method: SSO vs personal token.
Maria S: pd whoami -> "error: unauthorized". I filed a quick support ticket with infra: INF-4572. Pinged infra slack.
Alex K: For anyone prepping, here's a tiny checklist you can follow before taking a swap:
```
1) Okta VPN: login, 2FA success
2) ssh bastion as `oncall`
3) curl /health on nonprod and admin endpoints
4) pagerduty-cli whoami -> must show oncall role
5) open runbook and scan escalation steps
6) verify you can view logs in kibana (nonprod namespace)
```
Jordan T: Also confirm you can ack a test PagerDuty alert. I usually trigger via the internal test route: `POST https://ops.redwood.internal/test-alert?env=nonprod` (requires VPN).
Priya R: One gotcha: if you are on a corporate network w/ strict egress, the Okta VPN sometimes fails on the first try — re-open the client if you see routes missing.
Maria S: infra team already replied: they fixed my Okta email mapping. I can `pd whoami` now and see the oncall role. Thanks.
Alex K: Sweet. A couple of notes I added to the runbook:
  - If PagerDuty notifications aren't firing, check notification rules and then verify SNS relay: `kubectl get svc sns-relay -n ops`.
  - SSH key for bastion rotates monthly. If `Permission denied`, try `ssh-add ~/.ssh/oncall` and reattempt.
oncall-bot: Reminder: please add a brief post-shift note to `/runbooks/oncall/shift-logs/2026-03-15` with any anomalies. :memo:
Alex K: Will do. If anyone wants the swap, I can hand off at Fri 08:45 PT to overlap for 15 minutes. Otherwise I'll run the shift.
Jordan T: I'm good to take the overlap if you want the extra pair of eyes.
Maria S: I'll stand by for swaps next time — glad the checks are documented now. :thumbsup:
Alex K: Thanks team — leaving the runbook link and the quick smoke commands in the thread so it's easy to copy:
  - Runbook: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/nonprod-startup.md
  - Smoke command: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://nonprod-api.redwood.internal/health`
Priya R: Logged the swap in the oncall calendar. All good from infra side.
